title: Nationwide ICE civil detention facility locations
scope: Facilities that held at least one ICE civil immigration detainee Jan 1, 2025–Mar 10, 2026, plus newly disclosed openings. Includes dedicated facilities, jails, hold rooms, staging sites and hospitals. Not an assertion of current operation. Excludes criminal-only immigration detention and generally excludes CBP-only and ORR facilities.
contactCoverage: 14 facility-code records across 12 physical sites have operator main lines checked on 2026-10-26. All other records link to the ICE directory. Calls were not tested. Operator main lines are not direct detainee lines.
